releases.title: Register control, customer bank details and version history

changes.title: Full summaries for every register
changes.text: Review sales, returns, account sales, collections, discounts, points and payment totals across your authorized open registers.

changes.title: Register switching and cash adjustments
changes.text: Switch registers and record drawer cash in or out with a reason, user history and the existing approval controls.

changes.title: Reviewed closing of all registers
changes.text: Count and review each independent register before closing them in order. Changed totals stop closing; linked drawers retain one combined count.

changes.title: Bank details on the customer monitor
changes.text: Payment can automatically show receiving accounts, bank logos, an official payment QR and transfer instructions on the customer display.

changes.title: Editable bank display settings
changes.text: Upload bank logos and QR images, adjust sizes, preview the display and route accounts by register, currency and payment method.

changes.title: Updates and version management
changes.text: See running and server versions, check for deployed updates, and browse numbered releases with feature, improvement and fix counts.

changes.title: Payment tally guides and symbols
changes.text: Cash, card, bank transfer, debt and loyalty explanations include short, over and tallied indicators, with quiet motion and reduced-motion support.

changes.title: Visible release number and build checks
changes.text: The header shows the running interface version. Build checks keep the Python release, frontend package and release history aligned.

changes.title: Reliable bank display synchronization
changes.text: Bank details use cloneable snapshots between windows, clear after payment and preserve the customer's account selection during payment updates.
